description.value: An Italian bakery located on Commercial Drive in Vancouver. Offers indoor seating and accepts credit and debit card payments. Provides baked goods and pastries as a convenient stop for touring cyclists.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 50m; rack at 51m. Total: 3 spaces.
